messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PAGE fired to @maria (oncall) for service=hosted-inference, symptom=token-latency-spike (>95th pctl) across region-us-west-2. PD incident: INC-8452. Auto-escalation in 5m if no ack.

maria (oncall): seeing it, at dinner rn, DND on phone. trying to jump on laptop, ETA ~2m.

incident-bot: 4m elapsed — no ack from primary. Escalating to @ajay (secondary).

ajay (secondary): acked. I’m on it. can someone paste recent pod/host metrics?

ops-jen: grabbing logs. initial look shows consistent 502s from gpu-pool-3 router to runtime pods.

ops-jen: paste: ```
# last 30s logs (filtered)
router-3 ERROR upstream connect failed: connection reset by peer
runtime-7 WARN kv-cache-miss high
runtime-7 ERROR OOM killed process (out-of-memory)
```

sre-tilly: OOM on runtime-7 could explain latency spikes + retransmits. Did autoscaler attempt to spin new pods?

ops-jen: autoscaler did scale but new pods stuck in CrashLoopBackOff. kube events show `CrashLoopBackOff` due to startup failing on model load. digging.

ajay (secondary): trying to ssh into node `gpunode-12`. getting permission denied. firewall change?

manager-lara: I just got paged (manager escalation). I’m calling @ajay directly. :phone:

ajay (secondary): answered manager call. short version: primary unresponsive, secondary can access cluster but blocked from private model repo due to ACL change that happened ~10m before spike. looks like deployment rolled out a new IAM rule.

maria (oncall): I hit ack now. sorry for delay. DND suppressed mobile. adding context: I merged a quick infra change 11m ago toggling a storage policy to tighten access — intended to scope a service account. this could be the culprit.

support-ryan: support channel FYI — customers A, B, C seeing elevated 502/504s. one ticket opened by ACME (#INC-9221). adding short note to status page: "Investigating increased latency for inference in us-west-2".

sre-tilly: temporary mitigation options: 1) rollback IAM change, 2) route traffic to fallback-model variant in us-east-1 (no private repo dependency), 3) increase memory on runtime pods (but model load still blocked by ACL).

ops-jen: rollback IAM change requires owner approval + 2min to propagate. can do fast if approved.

manager-lara: rollback approved. please execute and confirm. if rollback fails, route to fallback in us-east-1.

ops-jen: rolling back SA policy now. command: ```
# revert
kubectl apply -f - <<EOF
apiVersion: rbac.authorization.k8s.io/v1
# patch to restore old binding
EOF
```

ops-jen: rollback applied. waiting for propagation. watching pods.

incident-bot: PD note — escalation timeout extended by manager (manual override).

ops-jen: pods restarting, model loads succeeding on runtime-9 and runtime-10. health checks passing. latency dropping.

ajay (secondary): confirming traffic normalizing. p95 latency from 1.8s -> 220ms over 3m. error rate falling from 6.3% -> 0.4%.

support-ryan: updated status page: "Mitigation in progress; errors reducing. Customers with impacted requests may see degraded responses between 12:40-12:52 PDT. Follow-up with impacted customers initiated."

maria (oncall): root cause: overly strict service-account policy rolled out in infra change — prevented model loader from pulling artifacts from private repo. rollback fixed access.

manager-lara: good triage. we stood up a quick workaround if rollback failed (traffic reroute) — nice to have that in runbook.

sre-tilly: quick customer impact numbers: window ~12m, peak error rate 6.3%, ~18k requests affected, revenue-impact estimate low but product-degraded for top-tier customers. recommend incident severity S3 -> S2 for follow-up because customer-facing.

support-ryan: I’ll consolidate and send customer-facing RCA draft after postmortem. tagging account managers.

ops-jen: creating short runbook PR to add guardrail checks to infra change pipeline to prevent SA bindings removal without a model-access integration test.

incident-bot: PD incident INC-8452 auto-resolved (status: mitigated).

maria (oncall): adding postmortem notes in #postmortems and will schedule a 30m blameless review tomorrow. action items: add pre-merge smoke test, add pager enrichment with DND fallback, update runbook for manager-escalation phone procedure.

manager-lara: thanks team. nice quick rollback and clear comms. support-ryan please follow up with impacted customers by EOD.

support-ryan: will do. drafting now.

sre-tilly: marking incident done in tracker. will own postmortem draft.

ajay (secondary): thanks all. keeping a note to add ACL checks to CI.

incident-bot: thread closed.
